evidence.reason: `recheck_baseline()` assigns the post-drain `self.preserved` digests, but the durable record at line 870 calls `self.phase("remeasured", preserved=sorted(self.preserved))`, which persists only the keys. Because a tick may have completed during the drain, the pre-admission receipt can be stale; a crash during the switch then leaves no durable post-drain digest baseline for the operator to verify preservation. This is a concrete crash-recovery gap in existing behavior, not merely a request for extra hardening.
